card.name: Inside GLP-1 drug names
card.fires_on: The final piece of GLP-1 related names: the "1" in GLP-1, the "lut" in liraglutide or semaglutide, and the "A" in SAXENDA. It fires in labels for these weight and diabetes drugs.
